meta.name: Nore – Album
meta.note: Single source of truth. Run `node design/build-tokens.mjs` to write design/tokens.css and common/src/main/java/dev/noreclient/util/ThemeTokens.java. Never edit those outputs by hand.

page.role: Ground: the black album card every page sits on.

page-raised.role: A loose sheet: modals, menus, settings groups, the instance header. One tone step above the page, no border.

page-raised-2.role: Hover on a loose sheet or a secondary (slot) button.

slot.role: Recessed slot: inputs, tracks, empty sticker places, code wells.

ghost.role: The printed ghost silhouette inside an empty slot (icon outline, dashed die line).

ink.role: Text and icons on the page. Called white pen.

ink-soft.role: Secondary text: descriptions, meta, inactive tabs.

ink-faint.role: Placeholders, disabled labels, ghost slot names. Only at 13px and up.

vinyl.role: The white rim of every die-cut sticker and the face of white stickers.

vinyl-ink.role: Text printed on a white sticker or a paper clipping.

vinyl-ink-soft.role: Secondary text on white stickers and clippings.

paper.role: News clippings and the login nameplate. Slightly greyer than vinyl so stickers still read as stickers on it.

cover.role: The album cover: launcher rail, installer sidebar, updater, login backdrop. Derived from the accent, never hard-coded.

cover-tab.role: An inactive index tab sitting on the cover.

cover-ink-soft.role: Group labels and secondary text on the cover.

scrim.role: Behind a loose sheet (modal). Flat, no blur.

accent.role: Nore violet. User-themable at runtime (--nore-accent). The Graj sticker, active slot pill, focus ring, selected keyline, switch on, icons on white stickers.

accent-light.role: Links, accent text on the page, the phosphor of focus on dark.

accent-deep.role: Pressed accent, progress fill under the Graj label, accent fields that carry small white text (contrast 5.9:1).

accent-ink.role: Text on an accent sticker. Large text only (22px heavy and up, 3.9:1); small text on accent uses accent-deep fields.

wait.role: Waiting, update available, beta, starting, pending invite.

error.role: Error, stopped by crash, danger, offline server.

info.role: Information, links to docs, new content to look at.

nore.role: Nore itself: Nore Client loader, Nore Hub players.

forge.role: Forge and NeoForge label sticker fill (dark text).

version.role: Minecraft version label sticker (white sticker, dark text).

kraft.role: Masking tape for notes and the event poster.

stops.role: Holographic foil for rare stickers (event and seasonal cosmetics only). Conic, rotated by pointer position. Never on the website's resting surfaces.

page.role: Lights out: the album in a dark room.

ink-soft.role: Raised for lights-out so secondary text keeps 4.5:1 where the dark is deepest.

phosphor.role: Glow-in-the-dark stickers. The only colour allowed to glow, and only during Halloween.

pumpkin.role: Pumpkin stickers, the event tab, Halloween countdown.

torch.role: The flashlight cone that follows the pointer.

bat.role: Bat and spider silhouettes (dark stickers with vinyl rim).

frost.role: Frost creeping from page corners, snow confetti.

display.use: Wordmark, page titles, instance names, the Graj label, big figures. Never below 18px, never for running text.

text.use: Everything a player reads to work: nav, labels, body, buttons, tables, forms.

pixel.use: Keycaps (Prawy Shift, F5) and fragments of the in-game UI shown on the website or launcher. In the game itself Minecraft's own font is used, never this.

code.use: Real code and JSON only (API docs, console).

game.use: All in-game text. Sizes are integer multiples of the 9px line only: 1x body, 2x titles, 3x hero numerals.

rim.note: Vinyl rim width of a die-cut sticker. Small label stickers 2px, buttons and cards 3px, hero objects 5px. In game 1 GUI px (3 device px at GUI scale 3).

flat.use: Page, slots and stickers at rest. Stickers are glued down: no shadow.

lift.use: A sticker being peeled: hover, drag, the moment before it sticks.

float.use: Loose sheets: modals, menus, toasts, dropdowns.

exit.use: Anything leaving. Always shorter than it arrived.

peel.use: A sticker peeling off (toggle off, remove, dismiss).

page.use: Page turn in the launcher and site sections.

stick.use: A sticker slapping into its slot (spring settle time).

ambient.use: Slow loops: flashlight sway, snow fall cycle, drift.

rub.use: The rub-down highlight sweep after pressing.

stick.use: Sticker slaps into a slot: about 11% overshoot, settles in ~420ms.

tab.use: Active tab and segmented pill travelling to a slot: ~4% overshoot.

knob.use: Switch knob (a dot sticker) re-sticking on the other side.

soft.use: Large objects: the album cover opening, the event poster.

stagger.use: List and grid entrances: 45ms apart, never more than 8 steps, so nothing takes over ~360ms to arrive.

stickScale.use: Start scale of a sticking sticker.

stickTilt.use: Start rotation of a sticking sticker (deg), lands on its own tilt.

tiltMax.use: Resting tilt range of placed stickers (deg, ±). In game always 0.

reduced.rule: prefers-reduced-motion or the in-app animation switch: distances become 0, springs become the out easing at quick duration, no tilt animation, no ambient loops (flashlight, snow, drift, foil). Colour and opacity changes stay so state remains legible. Event reveals become a 200ms crossfade.

game.note: All in-game values are in GUI pixels (multiplied by the player's GUI scale). Never place text at fractional scale; titles use g.scale(2) exactly.
